scripts.browser:install: vp exec playwright install chromium webkit
scripts.build: vp run @repo-chap/workflow#build && vp run @repo-chap/slack#build && vp run @repo-chap/companion#build && vp run @repo-chap/github#build && vp run @repo-chap/providers#build && vp run @repo-chap/execution#build && vp run @repo-chap/runtime#build && vp run @repo-chap/daemon#build && vp run repo-chap#build && vp run @repo-chap/desktop#build
scripts.typecheck: vp run build && vp exec tsc --noEmit --allowImportingTsExtensions
scripts.test: vp run build && vp exec node --test --test-reporter=dot tests/*.test.ts tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.check: vp run typecheck && vp run test
scripts.test:desktop: vp run build && vp exec node --test --test-reporter=dot tests/desktop*.electron.ts
scripts.test:systemd: vp run build && vp exec bash deploy/smoke-systemd.sh
scripts.test:pilot: vp run build && vp exec node --test --test-reporter=dot tests/pilot.test.mjs tests/pilot-workflows.test.mjs tests/pilot-journey.test.mjs
